name: Security Belt Scan
summary: Every release rides a conveyor through an X-ray arch; the one package with a coral glow is diverted to a human while the belt keeps rolling.
look: Top-down charcoal scanner hall with a slatted belt, lead-flap curtains and a lit arch roof. Inside the arch everything turns false-colour X-ray: teal outlines for healthy structure, a coral organic glow with a dashed bounding box for the anomaly.

components.name: Belt & rollers
components.role: scrolling slat pattern; the film's metronome

components.name: Scanner arch
components.role: roof panel with curtain, status LEDs and the lit Acme lockup

components.name: X-ray window
components.role: false-colour view of what is inside each release

components.name: Detection box
components.role: dashed coral bounding box around the suspect layer

components.name: Divert arm & tray
components.role: pushes one package off the belt to a human

components.name: Inspection monitor
components.role: enlarged X-ray, anomaly readout and Roll back / Acknowledge

motion.name: Belt scroll
motion.how: constant linear translateX, one slat per 8th note at 120 BPM; the only linear ease in the film

motion.name: Scan wipe
motion.how: clip-path inset reveals the X-ray view as each package crosses the arch, 0.4 s per item on the beat

motion.name: Divert push
motion.how: pusher arm rotates 26° with back.out(1.6) in 0.3 s on a snare hit; monitor punches in on the next beat

story: Hook: 38 dashboard tiles pile up on a belt with no scanner, '0 scanned'. Reveal: the camera cranes onto the arch roof and the Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse' light on the drop. Proof: releases flip to X-ray as they pass; deploy #2231 glows coral, is pushed to the inspection tray and the monitor reads 'Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231'; the human taps Roll back while the belt keeps moving. CTA: 'Caught before customers noticed.' over a belt of teal-ticked packages, Start free.
adapt: Swap the packages for whatever your product processes (pull requests, invoices, orders, uploads) and show your own check result inside the X-ray window.

references.note: X-ray art that shows the inside and outside of objects at once

fit.risk: Security and suspicion overtones; scan objects only, never people, and keep the palette calm.
